focus-ring.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.focus.ring.outer for new references.

spacing-stack-compact.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.space.stack.compact for new references.

surface-accent.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.surface.interactive.primary.default for new references.

surface-default.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.surface.canvas for new references.

text-default.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.text.primary for new references.

text-subtle.$description: Compatibility alias for component CSS; use sys.text.secondary for new references.

control-gap.$description: Semantic component geometry: control gap; ramp 200.

control-gap-compact.$description: Semantic component geometry: control gap compact; ramp 100.

control-gap-tight.$description: Semantic component geometry: control gap tight; ramp 150.

control-padding-block.$description: Block padding of a control, 4px; the control height sets its size.

control-padding-inline.$description: Button padding at the default size, 12px.

field-padding-inline.$description: Semantic component geometry: field padding inline; ramp 300.

badge-padding-block.$description: Semantic component geometry: badge padding block; ramp 050.

badge-padding-inline.$description: Semantic component geometry: badge padding inline; ramp 200.

inset-sm.$description: Semantic component geometry: inset sm; ramp 300.

inset-md.$description: Semantic component geometry: inset md; ramp 400.

stack-xs.$description: Semantic component geometry: stack xs; ramp 200.

stack-sm.$description: Semantic component geometry: stack sm; ramp 300.

stack-md.$description: Semantic component geometry: stack md; ramp 400.

inline-xs.$description: Semantic component geometry: inline xs; ramp 200.

inline-sm.$description: Semantic component geometry: inline sm; ramp 300.

inline-md.$description: Semantic component geometry: inline md; ramp 400.

progress-height.$description: Semantic component geometry: progress height; ramp 200.

radius-control.$description: Corner radius of a control at the default size: the brand recipe's radius.

radius-pill.$description: Fully rounded ends, for badges and pills.

shadow-panel.$description: Raised-panel shadow; the card elevation from the reference shadow scale, expanded into its parts.

control-padding-block-sm.$description: Block padding of a small control, 2px.

control-padding-block-lg.$description: Block padding of a large control, 8px.

control-padding-inline-sm.$description: Button padding at the small size, 10px.

control-padding-inline-lg.$description: Button padding at the large size, 16px.

stack-lg.$description: Semantic component geometry: stack lg; ramp 600.

stack-xl.$description: Semantic component geometry: stack xl; ramp 800.

page-gutter.$description: Semantic page geometry: the one left edge of a generated page, which every heading, control and card on it shares; ramp 600.

tab-indicator-width.$description: Selected tab underline: 2px, the bold border width (s222-m02, #2502 ruling 11).

radius-card.$description: Corner radius of a card or panel: twice the brand radius.

shadow-overlay.$description: Overlay shadow for menus and trays; the overlay elevation from the reference shadow scale, expanded into its parts.

radius-control-sm.$description: Corner radius of a small control: the brand radius less 2px.

radius-control-lg.$description: Corner radius of a large control: the brand radius plus 2px.

control-height-xs.$description: Extra-small control height, 24px (button, input, select, segmented control and combobox alike).

control-padding-inline-xs.$description: Button padding at the extra-small size, 8px.

control-icon-gap-sm.$description: Gap between an icon and a label in a small control, 6px.

control-icon-gap.$description: Gap between an icon and a label in a default control, 8px.

control-group-gap.$description: Gap between groups of controls, 12px (controls within a group are 8px apart).

text-weight-medium.$description: Medium weight: controls, labels and badges.
